## Summary

Describe the userscript behavior or repository tooling change.

## Validation

- [ ] I ran `npm test`.
- [ ] I manually tested affected userscript behavior where applicable.
- [ ] Every changed existing userscript has a higher `@version`.
- [ ] Match patterns and grants are no broader than necessary.
- [ ] No credentials, cookies, tokens, or webhook secrets are included.
- [ ] Published `@name`, `@namespace`, and file paths remain stable, or migration steps are documented.

## Publication

- [ ] This change is safe to publish from `main` after user-approved merge.
- [ ] Greasy Fork metadata or one-time import work is documented if needed.
